title: better item & recipes
description: A mod that adds more recipes and items to minecraft
body:
This mod adds new crafting recipes for vanilla Minecraft items.

🔹 No new biomes
🔹 No world generation 

The mod is lightweight and focuses only on crafting improvements.

new item:
chains this item is used to craft the chainmail arrmor
sus: its used to craft Suspicious Sand & Gravel

i will add more versions and more content soon.

⚙ Compatibility

Minecraft: 1.21.4

Mod Loader: NeoForge

Environment: singleplayer
